stem: Which statement best explains the organizational pattern used in the selection “Dive into a Sunken Museum”?
instruction: Use “Dive into a Sunken Museum” to answer the following question.

options.label: F
options.text: The descriptive organizational pattern explains how and why Jason Taylor’s artwork is created and displayed a certain way.

options.label: G
options.text: The compare-and-contrast organizational pattern shows how much bigger Jason Taylor’s park is than other underwater sculpture parks around the world.

options.label: H
options.text: The cause-and-effect organizational pattern shows why Jason Taylor decided to use people for his sculpture park and how the sculptures were made.

options.label: J
options.text: The advantage-and-disadvantage organizational pattern emphasizes both the positive and negative effects Jason Taylor’s artwork has on reefs.

visual_elements: text question with four labeled answer choices: F, G, H, J
